guard.source: Metadata-selection guard functions/constants extracted from Untitled36.ipynb

protocol.feedback_rule: Predict first. Reveal label after prediction. Add sample as exemplar only when wrong or rejected.
protocol.control: Add the same number of exemplars per class from non-error feedback samples, keeping memory growth count-matched.
protocol.same_failure_pattern_test: Frozen audit cases with a previously observed same true-class, prediction/rejection and rejection-reason signature.

interpretation: Weak positive signal only. Error-feedback accuracy improved slightly more than the count/class-matched random-memory control, but gains were small and inconsistent: 3 seeds improved, 6 were unchanged, and 1 regressed. The exact failure-pattern cohort was small. This does not establish strong generalization or human-like learning.
